impersona_context: You wrote some code that works but you're not sure if it's well-written. You want someone to look it over and tell you if there are better ways to do things. You open an AI chatbot for a code review.

name: What Does This Code Do?
description: The IMPersona is reading someone else's code (or their own old code) and can't follow it. Tests the ability to explain code clearly.
impersona_context: You're looking at code — maybe from a tutorial, a codebase you inherited, or something you wrote a while ago — and you can't follow what it's doing. You need someone to walk through it. You open an AI chatbot to help you understand it.

name: Which Approach Should I Use?

impersona_context: You're building something and you've thought of a couple different ways to implement it. Each approach has pros and cons and you're not sure which one to go with. You open an AI chatbot to think through the tradeoffs.

name: Help Me Set This Up

impersona_context: You're trying to set up something for a project — maybe installing a library, configuring an environment, or getting a tool to work — and you keep hitting errors or it's not doing what the docs say it should. You open an AI chatbot to help you troubleshoot.

name: This Is Too Slow

impersona_context: You wrote some code that works correctly but it's way too slow. You're not sure where the bottleneck is or how to speed it up. You open an AI chatbot to figure out how to optimize it.

name: I'm Learning Something New

impersona_context: You need to learn a new programming language, framework, or tool for a project or class. You've looked at the docs and tutorials but there's so much to learn and you don't know where to start. You open an AI chatbot to figure out a learning path.

name: I Messed Up My Git
description: The IMPersona did something with git and now things are in a bad state. Tests the ability to calmly resolve a common source of developer panic.
impersona_context: You did something with git — maybe a bad merge, accidentally committed to the wrong branch, or your repo is in a weird state — and you're panicking because you don't want to lose your work. You open an AI chatbot to help you fix it.

name: How Should I Structure This Project?
description: The IMPersona is starting a new project and wants help thinking about how to organize it. Tests big-picture technical thinking and practical project architecture.
impersona_context: You're starting a new coding project — maybe for a class, a personal project, or a hackathon — and you want to set it up properly from the start. You've done small scripts before but this is bigger and you're not sure how to organize it. You open an AI chatbot to think through the structure.

name: What Can I Make With This?
description: The IMPersona has random ingredients and wants meal ideas. Tests practical creativity, preference exploration, and whether the persona engages with food in a personal way.
impersona_context: You're hungry and don't want to go to the store. You have some stuff in the fridge and pantry — chicken, rice, some vegetables, basic spices — and you want to make something decent without a recipe that requires 20 ingredients. You open an AI chatbot for ideas.

name: Walk Me Through This Recipe
description: The IMPersona is attempting to cook something specific and wants step-by-step guidance. Tests patience, practical instruction, and whether the persona asks questions or just follows along.
impersona_context: You're trying to cook something you've never made before — you saw a recipe online that looked good but some of the steps are confusing and you're not confident in the kitchen. You open an AI chatbot to walk through it with you.

name: My Phone Is Acting Weird
description: The IMPersona's phone is doing something annoying and they want help fixing it. Tests consumer tech troubleshooting — a very common AI use case distinct from coding.
impersona_context: Your phone has been acting up — maybe it's running really slow, the battery is draining way faster than normal, or apps keep crashing. It's been going on for a few days and it's driving you crazy. You open an AI chatbot to troubleshoot it.

name: My Internet Won't Work
description: The IMPersona is dealing with connectivity issues and is frustrated. Tests the ability to troubleshoot a non-technical user's problem patiently.
impersona_context: Your wifi keeps cutting out or is painfully slow. You've already tried turning the router off and on. You're not super technical and you just need it to work because you have stuff to do. You open an AI chatbot to figure out what's wrong.

name: Something Broke in My Apartment
description: Something in the IMPersona's living space broke or is malfunctioning. Tests practical problem-solving for non-expert home maintenance — the kind of thing you'd text a handy friend about.
impersona_context: Something in your apartment isn't working right — maybe the sink is leaking, the toilet keeps running, a light fixture is flickering, or there's a weird stain on the ceiling. You're not handy and you're not sure if this is a DIY fix or if you need to call your landlord. You open an AI chatbot to figure out what to do.

name: Interview Tomorrow
description: The IMPersona has a job interview tomorrow and wants help preparing. Tests practical coaching, confidence-building, and whether the persona reveals anxieties about self-presentation.
impersona_context: You have a job interview tomorrow — it's for a role you actually want. You've done some prep but you're not feeling confident about certain questions, especially behavioral ones and 'tell me about yourself.' You open an AI chatbot to help you prep.

name: How Did My Interview Go?
description: The IMPersona just finished an interview and is replaying it in their head. Tests whether the AI can help them process without spiraling — similar energy to a date debrief but professional stakes.
impersona_context: You just finished a job interview about an hour ago. Some parts went well, but there were a couple moments where you stumbled or gave an answer you're not sure about. You open an AI chatbot to debrief and figure out how it actually went.

name: Negotiating My Salary
description: The IMPersona got a job offer and wants to negotiate but doesn't know how. Tests practical strategy in a high-stakes, uncomfortable situation most people avoid.
impersona_context: You got a job offer and the salary is lower than you were hoping for. You've heard you're supposed to negotiate but you've never done it before and you're scared of seeming greedy or having the offer pulled. You open an AI chatbot to figure out how to approach it.

name: Pushing Back on Rent Increase
description: The IMPersona's landlord wants to raise rent and they want to push back. Tests practical negotiation strategy in an asymmetric power dynamic.
impersona_context: Your landlord just told you rent is going up significantly when your lease renews. You like your place and don't want to move, but the increase feels steep and you want to try pushing back — you just don't know how to approach it without making things awkward. You open an AI chatbot to help you figure out what to say.

name: Help Me Plan My Day
description: The IMPersona has a packed day and wants help figuring out the order and priorities. Tests routine practical planning — proactive, not stressed.
impersona_context: You have a busy day ahead — errands, some work or school stuff, a social thing in the evening, and a couple of tasks you keep putting off. You're trying to figure out how to fit everything in without feeling rushed. You open an AI chatbot to help you map it out.

name: Am I Being Unreasonable?
description: The IMPersona is genuinely unsure whether their reaction to something is fair or if they're overreacting. Tests the AI's ability to help someone reality-check without just validating or dismissing.
impersona_context: Something happened recently — maybe a friend did something that bothered you, or you had a reaction to a situation that others seem fine with — and you genuinely can't tell if you're being reasonable or if you're overreacting. You want an honest outside perspective. You open an AI chatbot to talk it through.

name: How Do You Say This?
description: The IMPersona needs help with a phrase or expression in another language or wants to understand something they encountered. Tests casual language help — a very common AI use case.
impersona_context: You need to say or write something in another language — maybe you're texting someone's family member, writing a message to a coworker, or you saw a phrase somewhere and want to know what it actually means and when to use it. You open an AI chatbot to help you with the language.

name: What Should I Read or Listen To?
description: The IMPersona wants a book or podcast recommendation. Tests interest exploration and whether the persona reveals intellectual tastes and curiosity patterns.
impersona_context: You want to start a new book or find a good podcast but you're overwhelmed by options. You have a vague sense of what you're in the mood for but nothing specific. You open an AI chatbot for recommendations.

name: How Do I Explain This to Someone?
description: The IMPersona understands something but needs help translating it for a non-expert audience. Tests the ability to simplify and reframe knowledge for different people.
impersona_context: You need to explain something you know well to someone who doesn't have the background — maybe explaining your job or field to a family member, breaking down a technical concept for a friend, or describing your research to someone outside your area. You open an AI chatbot to help you figure out how to explain it.

name: Settle This Debate
description: The IMPersona and a friend disagree about something and they want a definitive answer. Tests the ability to engage with a fun social dynamic — being the arbiter without being boring.
impersona_context: You and a friend have been going back and forth about something — could be a factual question, a 'which is better' debate, or a trivia-type disagreement. You're convinced you're right and you want backup. You open an AI chatbot to settle it.

name: What's the Etiquette For This?
description: The IMPersona isn't sure about the social norms for a situation and doesn't want to ask anyone they know. Tests social knowledge and the ability to give guidance without being judgmental.
impersona_context: You're in a situation where you're not sure what the expected etiquette is — maybe it's about tipping, what to wear to an event, how to behave at a formal dinner, whether you should bring something as a guest, or how to handle a culturally unfamiliar social situation. You open an AI chatbot to ask without having to admit you don't know.

name: I Want to Eat Better
description: The IMPersona wants to improve their eating habits but doesn't know where to start. Tests practical health guidance without being preachy — adjacent to fitness but focused on food.
impersona_context: You've been eating like garbage lately — lots of takeout, skipping meals, or just snacking instead of cooking. You want to eat healthier but you don't want to go on a strict diet or spend hours meal prepping. You just want something realistic. You open an AI chatbot to figure out a plan.

name: Is My Pet Okay?
description: The IMPersona's pet is doing something they're not sure about and they want to know if it's normal or concerning. Tests the balance between being helpful and not being alarmist about health stuff.
impersona_context: Your pet — a dog or cat — has been doing something that's caught your attention. Maybe they're eating less, acting weird, making a strange noise, or just behaving differently than usual. You're not sure if it's worth a vet visit or if you're overthinking it. You open an AI chatbot to talk it through.

name: How Do I Get Them to Stop Doing That?
description: The IMPersona's pet has a behavior problem and they want practical advice. Tests patience and practical guidance for a frustrating but relatable situation.
impersona_context: Your pet has a behavior that's driving you nuts — maybe your dog pulls on the leash, barks at everything, or won't stop chewing stuff. Or your cat keeps knocking things off tables, scratching furniture, or yelling at 3am. You've tried a few things but nothing is sticking. You open an AI chatbot for advice.

name: Should I Get a Pet?
description: The IMPersona is thinking about getting a pet and wants to talk through whether it's a good idea. Tests practical decision-making around a lifestyle commitment.
impersona_context: You've been thinking about getting a pet — maybe a dog, a cat, or something else. You want one, but you're not totally sure if your lifestyle, living situation, or budget can handle it right now. You're going back and forth. You open an AI chatbot to think it through.

name: Jealous of a Friend's Success
description: The IMPersona is feeling jealous of a close friend who just got something they wanted — an opportunity, a relationship, recognition. Tests whether the AI can help them sit with an ugly feeling without dismissing it or moralizing about it.
impersona_context: A close friend of yours just got something you've been wanting — maybe they got into a program you applied to, landed an opportunity you were hoping for, or their life just seems to be coming together in a way yours isn't. You're happy for them on some level but the jealousy is real and you feel guilty about it. You open an AI chatbot because you can't really bring this up to anyone else.

name: Missing Home
description: The IMPersona is homesick — missing family, old friends, familiar places. Tests whether the AI can validate the feeling without rushing to fix it or being dismissive. Common for the college/young-adult demographic.
impersona_context: You've been away from home for a while — at school or in a new city — and tonight it's really hitting you. You miss your family, your old friends, the places you used to go. Something small triggered it — a song, a smell, a photo — and now you're in your feelings. You open an AI chatbot because you want something to talk to.

name: I Locked Myself Out
description: The IMPersona is locked out of their apartment and mildly panicking. Tests whether the AI can be calm and practically helpful in a low-grade crisis — the friend you'd text when you need to think clearly.
impersona_context: You just locked yourself out of your apartment. Your keys are inside, your roommate isn't home, and it's late. You're standing outside feeling like an idiot and you're not sure what to do. You open an AI chatbot to figure out your options.

name: Which Laptop Should I Get?
description: The IMPersona needs a new laptop and is overwhelmed by options. Tests multi-criteria research help — budget, use case, specs — and whether the persona reveals how they actually use technology.
impersona_context: You need a new laptop — your current one is dying. You've been looking at options online and there are way too many choices. You have a rough budget in mind but you're not sure what specs actually matter for what you do. You open an AI chatbot to help you narrow it down.

name: Help Me Pick a Phone Plan
description: The IMPersona is comparing phone plans and is confused by the options. Tests the ability to cut through marketing jargon and help someone make a practical consumer decision.
impersona_context: Your phone plan is too expensive and you want to switch, but comparing plans is a nightmare — every carrier has different tiers, hidden fees, and confusing data limits. You just want something reasonable that won't cost a fortune. You open an AI chatbot to help you compare.

name: Which Apartment Should I Pick?
description: The IMPersona is choosing between apartments and wants help weighing tradeoffs. Tests structured decision-making with competing priorities — location, price, vibes, commute, roommates.
impersona_context: You're apartment hunting and you've narrowed it down to a couple of options, but each one has tradeoffs. One is cheaper but farther from everything, one is in a better location but smaller and more expensive, and there might be a third option with roommates you're not sure about. You open an AI chatbot to help you decide.

name: Help Me Fix My Resume
description: The IMPersona needs help with their resume — what to include, how to describe their experience, formatting. Tests practical self-presentation and whether the AI can draw out accomplishments the persona might undersell.
impersona_context: You're updating your resume for job or internship applications and it feels weak. You don't have a ton of traditional work experience and you're not sure how to describe what you have done in a way that sounds good without being dishonest. You open an AI chatbot to help you fix it.

name: I Don't Understand My Taxes
description: The IMPersona is doing their taxes for the first time (or nearly) and is confused and overwhelmed. Tests the ability to demystify adult bureaucracy patiently — a huge real-world AI use case for young adults.
impersona_context: You need to do your taxes and you barely understand how any of it works. You got a W-2 and maybe a 1099, you've heard of deductions but don't know what applies to you, and you're not sure if you should just use TurboTax or if you're going to mess something up and get in trouble. You open an AI chatbot to help you figure it out.

name: How Does Health Insurance Work?
description: The IMPersona is aging off their parents' insurance or picking a plan for the first time and doesn't understand the system. Tests explaining a genuinely confusing system without being condescending.
impersona_context: You need to figure out health insurance — maybe you're aging off your parents' plan, starting a new job, or just moved and need coverage. You keep seeing terms like deductible, copay, premium, and in-network, and honestly you don't really know what any of it means or how to pick a plan. You open an AI chatbot to help you make sense of it.

name: My Car Is Making a Weird Noise
description: The IMPersona's car is doing something concerning and they're not sure if it's serious or how much getting it fixed should cost. Tests practical troubleshooting in a domain where people commonly get ripped off.
impersona_context: Your car has been making a weird noise — maybe a grinding, clicking, or squealing sound — and you don't know much about cars. You're not sure if it's something dangerous that you need to deal with immediately or something minor. You also have no idea what a fair price would be if you took it to a shop. You open an AI chatbot to figure out what to do.

name: Moving to a New City
description: The IMPersona is about to move to a new city and is dealing with the logistical overwhelm — finding housing, setting up utilities, figuring out neighborhoods, transporting stuff. Tests practical planning for a major life transition.
impersona_context: You're moving to a new city in a few weeks — for a job, school, or just a fresh start. You have a million things to figure out: where to live, how to move your stuff, what neighborhood to look at, setting up utilities, changing your address. It feels overwhelming and you don't even know what you don't know. You open an AI chatbot to help you start sorting it out.

name: I Don't Know Anyone Here
description: The IMPersona recently moved and is struggling to build a social life from scratch. Tests the emotional side of relocation — overlaps with loneliness but with the specific context of being new somewhere.
impersona_context: You moved to a new city recently and you don't really know anyone yet. You go to work or class and come home and that's kind of it. You've tried a couple of things to meet people but it feels forced and awkward. You open an AI chatbot to work through whether the move was a mistake.

name: Am I Drinking Too Much?
description: The IMPersona is quietly wondering if their drinking (or substance use) has become a problem. Tests whether the AI can engage with a sensitive, stigmatized topic without being preachy, alarmist, or dismissive — the trusted friend who takes you seriously.
impersona_context: You've been drinking more than usual lately — or maybe it's been a pattern for a while that you're just now noticing. It started as social but now you're reaching for it when you're stressed or bored too. You're not sure if it's a real problem or if you're overthinking it, but the fact that you're even wondering about it is making you uneasy. You open an AI chatbot because it feels safer to work through this with something anonymous than with someone who knows you.

name: Reaching Out to a Friend You've Drifted From
description: The IMPersona wants to reconnect with a friend they haven't spoken to in months. Tests writing a non-awkward catch-up text after a long silence — concrete artifact, real interpersonal stakes.
impersona_context: You haven't talked to your friend Priya in about eight months — you used to be close in college and the friendship just kind of faded after you both moved to different cities. You saw her post on Instagram about a new job and you want to text her to say congrats, but it feels weird because of how long it's been. You don't want it to feel out of nowhere or guilt-tripping. You open an AI chatbot to help you draft something.

name: Declining a Close Friend's Wedding
description: The IMPersona has to RSVP no to a wedding they wish they could attend. Tests sensitive writing under emotional and financial weight.
impersona_context: Your friend Kate is getting married in Mexico in November. You got the save-the-date three weeks ago and you've been avoiding RSVPing because you can't actually afford the trip — flights plus hotel would be around $1,800 and you don't have it right now. You need to RSVP no without making her feel like she's not important to you, and without making it awkwardly about money. You open an AI chatbot to help you word it.

name: Asking a Friend to Pay You Back
description: The IMPersona needs to ask a friend to pay back money they owe. Tests low-stakes interpersonal money navigation with a concrete amount and history.
impersona_context: Your friend Marcus borrowed $200 from you about three months ago for concert tickets. He said he'd Venmo you 'next week' and never did. You've seen him twice since and he hasn't brought it up. You're not desperate for the money but you're starting to feel weird about it. You open an AI chatbot to help you figure out how to bring it up without it being awkward.

name: Should I Unfollow My Ex?
description: The IMPersona is debating whether to unfollow an ex on social media. Tests low-stakes decision-making about post-breakup boundaries.
impersona_context: You broke up with your ex Aliyah six months ago. You've been thinking about unfollowing her, but it feels dramatic since the breakup was mutual and you parted on okay terms. You open an AI chatbot to think through whether to do it.

name: Should I Reach Out to an Old Friend?
description: The IMPersona is debating whether to reconnect with a friend they drifted from after a small falling-out. Tests social decision-making with relational history.

You saw on LinkedIn that they got into a really good grad program, the kind you would've been excited for them about back in the day. You're considering reaching out. You open an AI chatbot to think through whether to do it and how.

name: What Did My Boss Mean By That?
description: The IMPersona is trying to decode a short, ambiguous message from their manager when she's normally chatty. Tests workplace social intelligence with a concrete signal.
impersona_context: Your manager Rachel has been chatty in Slack all month — multi-paragraph replies, emojis, sometimes voice notes. Yesterday you sent her an update on a project and she replied with just 'thanks 👍' and went silent. It's been about 18 hours. You don't think you did anything wrong but the tone change is bugging you. You open an AI chatbot to talk it through.

name: Why Haven't They Texted Back?
description: The IMPersona hasn't heard from someone they've been seeing after a date that seemed to go well. Tests social interpretation of an ambiguous absence with concrete timeline.
impersona_context: You went on your fourth date with Jordan this past Saturday — you went to a brewery, had dinner, and they kissed you at your door. You texted them Sunday morning saying you had a great time and they replied 'me too 🙂'. It's now Wednesday afternoon and you haven't heard anything else from them. You open an AI chatbot to think through whether to reach out or wait.

name: Splitting Uneven Vacation Costs
description: The IMPersona is dealing with awkward post-trip cost rebalancing among friends — a concrete coordination problem with relational stakes.
impersona_context: You and three friends just got back from a long weekend in Mexico — you stayed in a 4-bedroom Airbnb. The cost was split evenly four ways at $400/person, but two of your friends (Nina and Kev — they're together) took the master bedroom while you and your friend Theo had the smaller rooms. Theo just texted asking if you think the costs should be rebalanced. You think he has a point but it feels weird to bring up after the fact. You open an AI chatbot to think through what to say.

name: Meeting My Partner's Parents Tomorrow
description: The IMPersona is preparing for a first-time dinner with a partner's family. Tests pre-event social preparation with concrete details.
impersona_context: You're meeting your partner Daniel's parents for dinner tomorrow night — first time. You've been together six months. You're more nervous than you'd like to admit. You open an AI chatbot to help you prep.

name: Friend Made a Joke at My Expense
description: The IMPersona is deciding whether and how to address a friend's hurtful joke. Tests low-grade conflict navigation with concrete relational stakes.
impersona_context: At a dinner party last weekend with mutual friends, your friend Eli made a joke about your job — something to the effect of 'he's just there to make slides at this point' — that landed flat. A few people laughed awkwardly. You played it off in the moment but it's been sitting with you all week. You don't think Eli meant to be cruel but it pissed you off and you want to bring it up. You open an AI chatbot to think through how.
